{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Red oversized knit sweater, relaxed fit, hip-length hem, vibrant crimson #E3001C, soft cotton-blend wool
Dark wash straight-leg jeans, medium rise, ankle length, classic indigo, durable denim
White leather minimalist sneakers, low top, slip-on style, pristine white, smooth calfskin
Gold hoop earrings and a structured red tote bag
This outfit honors her desire for a red top while perfectly suiting a casual autumn meetup with friends. The relaxed sweater offers warmth without looking too formal, keeping the vibe cozy and expressive. Pairing it with dark denim and clean sneakers grounds the bold color in everyday comfort, ensuring she feels stylish yet at ease throughout the day."}
